headline: Mooring County Quickens as Expanse Stirs Anew
war_summary: Since the last edition Mooring County has quickened, logging ten changes in two hours and fifty-five in the day about The Wind Hills and Gravekeeper's Holdfast, now standing five Warden, six Colonial and one ruined, with 17,812 Colonial and 17,069 Warden casualties in twenty-four hours. The Weathered Expanse has stirred anew with four in two hours and thirty-five in the day about Crow's Nest and Wightwalk, now two Warden, four Colonial and three ruined, with 7,096 and 7,083 losses. Linn Mercy has eased to none in two hours and four in six with thirty-five in the day about Outwich Ranch and Rotdust, holding ten Colonial posts and one ruined. Callum's Cape remains silent in the short wires with thirty-five in the day about Ire and Scouts Jest at three Warden to four Colonial, while Marban Hollow shows none in six hours and thirteen in the day about Checkpoint Bua at three apiece with two ruined. Callahan's Passage reports no changes despite heavy losses.
